resources.string: RickNotes opens the PDFs in your Study folder directly and saves your ink in files beside them, the same folder your sync app mirrors to Google Drive. Android only allows that with "All files access". RickNotes never changes your PDFs and only reads and writes inside the Study folder you pick. Turn it on for RickNotes, then come back.
Choose the folder that holds your courses, chapters and PDFs. RickNotes shows what is inside it and remembers your choice. You can change it later in Settings.
No PDFs in this folder yet.
Touch, hover over or press pen buttons in the grey area. To check a button while hovering, hold the pen still just above the area and press it.
